Ruling: representation; i8863 p. 9, Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 3. Both add lines 2a, 2b and 2c; the project counts them only for an eligible student of the return (dependent.edu_student), zero otherwise. Part III reads the line only for an eligible student, and the new reader f8863.adj_dep (the BUG-0932 notice) should not count a student no credit is figured for. The one completed value witness (generated return 279: project $0, reply $3,840.14) is a student who is not an eligible student of the return. executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/dependent.json; 2,761 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 1,724 partial records).

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 15, Qualifying Surviving Spouse, "2. You have a child or stepchild (not a foster child)". The line asks dependent.own_child (son, daughter or stepchild) only for a person listed as a child on a qualifying-surviving-spouse return with its tests answered Yes, and is No otherwise (BUG-1277). The reply replaces it with the qualifying-child tests (age, residency, support, claimants), which do not decide whether the person is the filer's own child or stepchild and never read dependent.own_child. executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/dependent.json; 2,761 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 1,724 partial records): no completed-return difference (the line is read only on such returns).

Ruling: model error; the line is 'listed as your child, and lived with you for all of 2025' (relationship child and dependent.lived_all_year); the son-daughter-stepchild filter of BUG-1277 is applied where it is read (household.qss_children_all_year), not here. The reply makes the line depend on dependent.own_child_if_qss and the qualifying-child tests, so on every return other than a qualifying-surviving-spouse one it is No: completed value witness classm.f8960.1.deepseek, project Yes, reply No. executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/dependent.json; 2,761 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 1,724 partial records).
